instruction: Open the provided init.ifc model in Bonsai and use init_plan.png as the plan reference. Correct the spatial containment so ground-floor elements belong to the Ground Floor storey and first-floor elements belong to the First Floor storey. Save the completed IFC4 model as result.ifc and export a storey summary as result.csv using a Bonsai or IfcCSV-style workflow. The result should keep one project, one site, and one building, with exactly two building storeys named Ground Floor and First Floor. It should contain exactly eight walls and two slabs, with no building element proxies or furniture. Through IfcRelContainedInSpatialStructure relationships, Ground Floor should contain exactly GF South Wall, GF North Wall, GF West Wall, GF East Wall, and GF Slab. First Floor should contain exactly FF South Wall, FF North Wall, FF West Wall, FF East Wall, and FF Slab. The CSV should have headers Storey, ElementCount, and TotalSlabArea. It should contain exactly two rows: Ground Floor with ElementCount 5 and TotalSlabArea 63.0 within 0.1, and First Floor with ElementCount 5 and TotalSlabArea 63.0 within 0.1. Other details may vary.
